title: Koszul restriction surjective
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, X=Spec(A) [def-pc-scheme], f a finite sequence, and U the union of its principal opens [def-sc-koszul-open-system]. Let E be in D_QCoh(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category], and let v_e be two-sided inverses to the restricted Koszul augmentations. Every morphism from the restricted structure object to E restricted to U has the form v_e followed by restriction of a morphism I_e to E at some finite stage e.

proof.text: Use the affine quasi-coherent derived equivalence to represent E by a termwise quasi-coherent complex F, corresponding to the A-module complex M. Each Koszul tail is bounded finite free. K-projectivity identifies its Hom-complex H^0 with derived Hom, naturally in the power transitions.

Apply the canonical Koszul-to-Cech-derived-sections comparison to F. It is a quasi-isomorphism. Exactness of filtered colimits of modules identifies H^0 of the source with the filtered colimit of the derived Hom groups. Evaluation at 1 identifies H^0 of derived sections with Hom from the restricted structure object. The explicit localization formula makes the comparison leg equal to restriction followed by the inverse augmentation.

The supplied two inverse identities uniquely determine v. Surjectivity on H^0 of the comparison and representation of each filtered-colimit element at a finite stage give e and phi with v_e composed with restriction(phi) equal to the requested psi.

proof_origin.place: Tag 08DD, Proposition 36.9.5, H^0 argument; read from the Stacks online edition

theorem koszulOpenHom_restriction_surjective
    (A : Type uMain) [CommRing A] (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wMain}
      (SheafOfModules.{uMain} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ V : (Spec (.of A)).Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{wMain}
      (SheafOfModules.{uMain} ((moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace).over V))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wMain}
      (SheafOfModules.{uMain} (moduleRings (koszulOpen A r f).toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    (E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory (Spec (.of A)))
    (v : ∀ e : ℕ,
      ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{uMain} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace)
                (koszulOpen A r f)) ⋙
              Equivalence.functor
                (C := SheafOfModules.{uMain}
                  ((moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace).over (koszulOpen A r f)))
                (D := SheafOfModules.{uMain}
                  (moduleRings (koszulOpen A r f).toScheme.toRingedSpace))
                (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (koszulOpen A r f))).mapDerivedCategory.obj
        (koszulOpenStructure A) ⟶
      ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{uMain} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace)
                (koszulOpen A r f)) ⋙
              Equivalence.functor
                (C := SheafOfModules.{uMain}
                  ((moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace).over (koszulOpen A r f)))
                (D := SheafOfModules.{uMain}
                  (moduleRings (koszulOpen A r f).toScheme.toRingedSpace))
                (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (koszulOpen A r f))).mapDerivedCategory.obj
        (koszulOpenObject A r f e))
    (hv₁ : (∀ e : ℕ,
        ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{uMain} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace)
                  (koszulOpen A r f)) ⋙
                Equivalence.functor
                  (C := SheafOfModules.{uMain}
                    ((moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace).over (koszulOpen A r f)))
                  (D := SheafOfModules.{uMain}
                    (moduleRings (koszulOpen A r f).toScheme.toRingedSpace))
                  (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (koszulOpen A r f))).mapDerivedCategory.map
          (koszulOpenUnit A r f e) ≫ v e = 𝟙 _))
    (hv₂ : (∀ e : ℕ, v e ≫
        ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{uMain} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace)
                  (koszulOpen A r f)) ⋙
                Equivalence.functor
                  (C := SheafOfModules.{uMain}
                    ((moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace).over (koszulOpen A r f)))
                  (D := SheafOfModules.{uMain}
                    (moduleRings (koszulOpen A r f).toScheme.toRingedSpace))
                  (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (koszulOpen A r f))).mapDerivedCategory.map
          (koszulOpenUnit A r f e) = 𝟙 _))
 :
    let R := ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{uMain}
      (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace) (koszulOpen A r f)) ⋙
      Equivalence.functor
        (C := SheafOfModules.{uMain}
          ((moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace).over (koszulOpen A r f)))
        (D := SheafOfModules.{uMain}
          (moduleRings (koszulOpen A r f).toScheme.toRingedSpace))
        (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (koszulOpen A r f))).mapDerivedCategory
    ∀ ψ : R.obj (koszulOpenStructure A) ⟶ R.obj E.1,
      ∃ (e : ℕ) (φ : koszulOpenObject A r f e ⟶ E.1), v e ≫ R.map φ = ψ
